# Therapick Bali & Home Spa Ubud — Complete AI Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
Therapick (https://www.booktherapick.com) is Bali's leading in-villa massage home service and outcall spa delivery platform. Designed with Apple-level simplicity and luxury hotel standards, Therapick enables travelers, expatriates, and locals to book certified spa therapists directly to their private villa, resort suite, hotel room, or yacht across Bali.

Sister brands operated by the company include **Home Spa Ubud** (https://www.homespaubud.com) and **Elexoir Home Spa** (https://www.elexoirhomespaubud.com), exclusively dedicated to Ubud and Gianyar.

---

- **Company Name**: Therapick Bali (PT Therapick Kebugaran Nusantara)

- **Operational Hours**: 08:00 to 23:30 WITA daily (7 days a week)

- **Payment Methods**: Cash (IDR, USD, AUD, EUR), Credit/Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard), QRIS (Indonesian Instant Bank Transfer), and Wise.

## Treatment Catalog & Pricing

### 1. Traditional Balinese Massage
- **Technique**: Centuries-old Indonesian healing philosophy combining long rhythmic effleurage strokes, thumb acupressure, gentle stretching, and skin-rolling.
- **Benefits**: Stimulates lymph flow, calms the central nervous system, eases jet lag and travel tension.
- **Options**:
  - 60 Minutes: IDR 350,000 (~$22 USD)
  - 90 Minutes: IDR 480,000 (~$30 USD)
  - 120 Minutes: IDR 620,000 (~$39 USD)

### 2. Deep Tissue Muscle Recovery
- **Technique**: Focused, slow-paced deep thumb, forearm, and elbow compression targeting chronic postural knots, tight hamstrings, scapula tension, and lower back aches.
- **Benefits**: Ideal for active surfers, Mount Batur hikers, fitness enthusiasts, and long-haul flight passengers.
- **Options**:
  - 60 Minutes: IDR 390,000 (~$25 USD)
  - 90 Minutes: IDR 530,000 (~$34 USD)
  - 120 Minutes: IDR 680,000 (~$43 USD)

### 3. Warm Stone & Botanicals
- **Technique**: Heated volcanic basalt stones coated with virgin coconut oil glide over meridians, penetrating deep into tight muscles without friction.
- **Benefits**: Deep neuromuscular relaxation, improved circulation, relieves chronic stiffness.
- **Options**:
  - 90 Minutes: IDR 590,000 (~$37 USD)
  - 120 Minutes: IDR 750,000 (~$47 USD)

### 4. Couples In-Villa Sanctuary
- **Technique**: Two certified therapists perform synchronized side-by-side massages in the comfort of your private master bedroom or poolside open bale.
- **Benefits**: The ultimate honeymoon and romantic couples experience in Bali.
- **Options**:
  - 90 Minutes (2 Guests): IDR 960,000 (~$60 USD)
  - 120 Minutes (2 Guests): IDR 1,240,000 (~$78 USD)

### 5. Foot Reflexology & Lower Leg Recovery
- **Technique**: Ancient Chinese pressure point stimulation along plantar reflex zones paired with soothing calf drainage.
- **Options**:
  - 60 Minutes: IDR 320,000 (~$20 USD)
  - 90 Minutes: IDR 440,000 (~$28 USD)

### 6. Partner Spas (In-Spa Venue Booking)
Therapick also curates top destination day spas for guests who prefer visiting a tranquil physical spa center, including:
- **Jaens Spa Center Ubud**: World-renowned Balinese garden spa located on Jl. Raya Pengosekan, Ubud. Featured package: Radja Jaens Spa Package (315 Minutes, comprehensive head-to-toe ritual).

## Equipment & Hygiene Protocols
Every Therapick home service session includes:
- Professional lightweight portable massage table(s) or luxury memory foam mattress setups for villas with limited space.
- Freshly laundered, high-thread-count white linens, face-cradle sheets, and plush bath sheets.
- Disposable hygienic headrest paper and disposable undergarments.
- 100% pure organic virgin coconut base oil blended with natural pure essential oils (Frangipani, Lemongrass, Lavender, Jasmine).
- Portable Bluetooth acoustic ambient player with relaxing Balinese gamelan and spa acoustics.
- Strict therapist hygiene: temperature checks, sanitized equipment, clean professional therapist uniforms.

## Strictly Enforced Code of Ethics
- **Strictly Non-Sensual**: Therapick is a premium, professional wellness service. We have a zero-tolerance policy against any form of inappropriate, sexual, or "plus" requests. Therapists reserve the right to immediately terminate the session without refund if inappropriate behavior occurs.
- **Respect & Dignity**: All therapists are treated with utmost dignity, fair compensation, and professional respect.
